description: Image Description: The image depicts a modern, elegant bathroom interior. The bathroom features a marble countertop with a sink on the left side. On the countertop, there are toiletries, including a set of blue bottles. Below the countertop, a towel is hanging. Adjacent to the sink, there is a bathtub with a curved edge, partially visible, and it has a towel draped over its side. Above the bathtub, there is a towel rack mounted on the wall, holding several neatly folded white towels
